SUPPLY TO FLIGHT

Connect the fuel supply

The same calculation chooses purchases, deliveries, airport stocks and aircraft uplift. Each airport can only put fuel on board when its supply and inventory allow it.

  1. Purchase
  2. Delivery
  3. Airport stock
  4. Aircraft uplift

Choose your airports to generate the connected supply network.

Each departure is one supply window. Deliveries arrive before uplift. A lead time of one window means fuel dispatched now is available at the next departure.
